title: Slipsnare
summary: Slipsnare is a power that allows the caster to create a bundle of invisible rope that wraps around the target's ankles, immobilizing them.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale used this spell on a roof in Venice, Italy. It successfully trapped Zhalia Moon, allowing him to take on Tantras. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Dante later attempted to use it on a Silent Soldier whilst racing down a cliff to the Pyramid of the Sun but was unsuccessful. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

'''Slipsnare''' is a power that allows the caster to create a bundle of invisible rope that wraps around the target's ankles, immobilizing them.

== History ==
[[Dante Vale]] used this spell on a roof in [[Venice, Italy]]. It successfully trapped [[Zhalia Moon]], allowing him to take on [[Tantras]]. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}} 

Dante later attempted to use it on a [[Silent Soldier]] whilst racing down a cliff to the [[Pyramid of the Sun]] but was unsuccessful. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}
